identity: Black-red aristocrats drain built as a 13-one-drop aggro curve. Susurian Voidborn ('Whenever this creature or another creature or artifact you control dies, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life') turns every body and artifact the deck loses into reach, while Weftstalker Ardent bills the same permanents on the way in and Lightless Evangel banks them as +1/+1 counters. Weapons Manufacturing banks a 2-damage Munitions charge off each of the 10/24 nontoken artifacts, and those charges are only worth damage when something removes them — the Munitions clause is 'When this token LEAVES THE BATTLEFIELD, it deals 2 damage to any target' — so the list carries 6/24 cards that can cash one (Umbral Collar Zealot 2, Slagdrill Scrapper 2, Embrace Oblivion 2), 4/24 of them repeatably. Rust Harvester is the one repeatable non-combat damage source. The deck manufactures its own Void condition on 16/24 cards, which upgrades Plasma Bolt to 3 to the face and Tragic Trajectory to -10/-10 for one mana each.

mainboard.name: Susurian Voidborn
mainboard.oracle_text:
Whenever this creature or another creature or artifact you control dies, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
Warp {B} (You may cast this card from your hand for its warp cost. Exile this creature at the beginning of the next end step, then you may cast it from exile on a later turn.)
mainboard.role: Payload/Payoff — the locked kill mechanism; every creature/artifact death is 1 drain + 1 life

mainboard.name: Weftstalker Ardent
mainboard.oracle_text:
Whenever another creature or artifact you control enters, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.
Warp {R} (You may cast this card from your hand for its warp cost. Exile this creature at the beginning of the next end step, then you may cast it from exile on a later turn.)
mainboard.role: Payload/Payoff — reach on the ENTER side of the same permanents Voidborn drains on the DIE side

mainboard.name: Lightless Evangel
mainboard.oracle_text: Whenever you sacrifice another creature or artifact, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
mainboard.role: Payload/Payoff — converts each sacrifice into permanent combat damage

mainboard.name: Weapons Manufacturing
mainboard.oracle_text: Whenever a nontoken artifact you control enters, create a colorless artifact token named Munitions with "When this token leaves the battlefield, it deals 2 damage to any target."
mainboard.role: Payload/Payoff (rare 1 of 2 spent) — each nontoken artifact ETB banks a Munitions worth 2 damage

mainboard.name: Rust Harvester
mainboard.oracle_text:
Menace
{2}, {T}, Exile an artifact card from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature, then it deals damage equal to its power to any target.
mainboard.role: Payload/Engine (rare 2 of 2 spent) — 'Menace // {2}, {T}, Exile an artifact card from your graveyard: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature, then it deals damage equal to its power to any target.' The only repeatable non-combat damage source in the list; MV1 nontoken artifact

mainboard.name: Kavaron Harrier
mainboard.oracle_text: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {2}. If you do, create a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token that's tapped and attacking. Sacrifice that token at end of combat.
mainboard.role: Threat/Payoff — 1-mana artifact creature that manufactures one guaranteed death per combat for {2}

mainboard.name: Hullcarver
mainboard.role: Threat — {B} 1/1 nontoken artifact creature whose entire oracle text is 'Deathtouch'; it is legal fodder for the outlets, but nothing on the card itself says so

mainboard.name: Slagdrill Scrapper
mainboard.oracle_text: {2}, {T}, Sacrifice another artifact or land: Draw a card.
mainboard.role: Engine/Outlet — '{2}, {T}, Sacrifice another artifact or land: Draw a card.' Repeatable Munitions consumer, MV1 nontoken artifact, and net-positive on cards

mainboard.name: Umbral Collar Zealot
mainboard.oracle_text: Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)
mainboard.role: Engine/Outlet — the only mana-free unlimited sac outlet in the pool

mainboard.name: Nutrient Block
mainboard.oracle_text:
Indestructible (Effects that say "destroy" don't destroy this artifact.)
{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: You gain 3 life.
When this artifact is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, draw a card.
mainboard.role: Engine/Outlet — 1-mana nontoken artifact; self-sacrificing outlet ({2}, {T}, not free) that replaces itself with a card

mainboard.name: Melded Moxite
mainboard.oracle_text:
When this artifact enters, you may discard a card. If you do, draw two cards.
{3}, Sacrifice this artifact: Create a tapped 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token.
mainboard.role: Engine/Outlet — nontoken artifact, ETB optional discard-for-two, later self-sacrifices into a Robot for {3}

mainboard.name: Plasma Bolt
mainboard.oracle_text:
Plasma Bolt deals 2 damage to any target.
Void — Plasma Bolt deals 3 damage instead if a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn.
mainboard.role: Reach — 1 mana for 2 to the face, 3 whenever Void is live (sorcery speed)

mainboard.name: Embrace Oblivion
mainboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice an artifact or creature.
Destroy target creature or Spacecraft.
mainboard.role: Interaction/Outlet — 1-mana unconditional kill whose additional cost is itself a Voidborn drain

mainboard.name: Tragic Trajectory
mainboard.oracle_text:
Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
Void — That creature gets -10/-10 until end of turn instead if a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn.
mainboard.role: Interaction — 1-mana -2/-2, or -10/-10 on any turn a permanent has left the battlefield (sorcery speed)

mainboard.name: Geothermal Bog
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {B} or {R}.)
This land enters tapped.
mainboard.role: Land — the only free BR dual in the pool (enters tapped)

sideboard.name: Drill Too Deep
sideboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Put five charge counters on target Spacecraft or Planet you control.
• Destroy target artifact.
sideboard.role: Answers artifacts — oracle is 'Destroy target artifact'; it cannot touch an enchantment, so the previous 'noncreature_permanents' label was over-broad

sideboard.name: Cut Propulsion
sideboard.oracle_text: Target creature deals damage to itself equal to its power. If that creature has flying, it deals twice that much damage to itself instead.
sideboard.role: Answers aggressive large threats and fliers — the damage scales with the creature's POWER, so a high-toughness / low-power blocker survives it

sideboard.name: Lithobraking
sideboard.oracle_text: Create a Lander token. Then you may sacrifice an artifact. When you do, Lithobraking deals 2 damage to each creature. (A Lander token is an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.")
sideboard.role: Answers wide_boards — makes its own Lander to pay the sacrifice, and every creature it kills on our side is a Voidborn drain

sideboard.name: Ruinous Rampage
sideboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Ruinous Rampage deals 3 damage to each opponent.
• Exile all artifacts with mana value 3 or less.
sideboard.role: Answers lifegain (mode 1) and artifacts (mode 2) — 3 uninteractable points to the face when the opponent is gaining life faster than the 1-per-death drain, or a one-sided-when-boarded-correctly artifact exile

sideboard.name: Dauntless Scrapbot
sideboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, exile each opponent's graveyard. Create a Lander token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.")
sideboard.role: Answers graveyard — and is itself a nontoken artifact creature, so it is a Weapons Manufacturing trigger and its Lander is fodder
